```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")   # english day and month names, also on a danish computer

grey <- "#6b7280"
ink  <- "#1f2328"
dir_colors <- c(down = "#2563eb", none = "#cbd5e1", up = "#f97316")
dir_labels <- c(down = "Down-regulation", none = "No regulation", up = "Up-regulation")
model_labels <- c(ens = "Ensemble", mnl = "Multinomial lasso", xgb = "XGBoost",
                  persist = "Persistence", clim = "Benchmark (last 28 days)")
horizon_labels <- c("0-1h" = "0–1 h", "1-2h" = "1–2 h", "2-3h" = "2–3 h", "3-4h" = "3–4 h",
                    "day-ahead" = "Day-ahead")

# everything below comes from forecasts/ and results/, nothing is typed in by hand
read_if <- function(f) if (file.exists(f)) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
# latest forecasts from the logs (forecasts are only added, never changed)
intra  <- read_if("forecasts/intraday_log.csv")
if (!is.null(intra)) intra <- filter(intra, issue == max(issue))
dayah  <- read_if("forecasts/dayahead_log.csv")
if (!is.null(dayah)) dayah <- filter(dayah, date == max(date))
live   <- read_if("results/live_scored.csv")
scores <- read_if("results/direction_scores.csv")
tests  <- read_if("results/direction_tests.csv")
calib  <- read_if("results/calibration.csv")
spread <- read_if("results/spread_scores.csv")
sptest <- read_if("results/spread_tests.csv")
info   <- read_if("results/backtest_info.csv")
info_v <- function(n) info$value[info$name == n]

pct   <- function(x, d = 0) paste0(format(round(100 * x, d), nsmall = d), "%")
eur   <- function(x) paste0(if (x >= 0) "+" else "−", format(round(abs(x)), big.mark = ","))
p_txt <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste("p =", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3))
dk    <- function(t) with_tz(t, "Europe/Copenhagen")

skill_of <- function(h, m = "ens", per = "all") scores$skill[scores$horizon == h & scores$model == m & scores$period == per]
test_of  <- function(h, a = "ens", b = "clim") tests[tests$horizon == h & tests$model_a == a & tests$model_b == b, ]

chart_layout <- function(p, xtitle = "", ytitle = "") {
  p |>
    layout(paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           font = list(family = "Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif", color = grey),
           xaxis = list(title = xtitle, showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, color = grey, linecolor = "#e5ddd3"),
           yaxis = list(title = ytitle, color = grey, gridcolor = "#f1ebe4", zerolinecolor = "#cfc6bb"),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18, font = list(color = ink)),
           hovermode = "x unified",
           hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#ffffff", bordercolor = "#efe6dc", font = list(color = ink)),
           margin = list(t = 20)) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}

# stacked probabilities per quarter, time axis for a whole day, labels for a few hours
prob_chart <- function(fc, xtitle, day = FALSE) {
  fc$x <- if (day) dk(fc$time) else fc$label
  p <- plot_ly(fc, x = ~x)
  for (cl in c("down", "none", "up")) {
    p <- p |> add_bars(y = fc[[cl]], name = dir_labels[[cl]], marker = list(color = dir_colors[[cl]]),
                       hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.0%}<extra>", dir_labels[[cl]], "</extra>"))
  }
  p |> chart_layout(xtitle) |>
    layout(barmode = "stack", bargap = 0.15, yaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1)),
           xaxis = if (day) list(type = "date", tickformat = "%H:%M", dtick = 2 * 3600 * 1000)
                   else list(type = "category"))
}

# expected spread with the 80% band
spread_chart <- function(fc, xtitle, day = FALSE) {
  fc$x <- if (day) dk(fc$time) else fc$label
  plot_ly(fc, x = ~x) |>
    add_lines(y = ~q10, line = list(width = 0), showlegend = FALSE, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
    add_lines(y = ~q90, line = list(width = 0), fill = "tonexty", fillcolor = "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
              name = "80% band", hovertemplate = "%{y:.0f} €/MWh<extra>90%</extra>") |>
    add_lines(y = ~mean, name = "Expected spread", line = list(color = "#f97316", width = 3),
              hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>Expected</extra>") |>
    chart_layout(xtitle) |>
    layout(xaxis = if (day) list(type = "date", tickformat = "%H:%M", dtick = 2 * 3600 * 1000)
                   else list(type = "category"))
}

# latest intraday forecast (ensemble)
has_intra <- !is.null(intra)
if (has_intra) {
  ie <- intra |> filter(model == "ens") |> arrange(time) |>
    mutate(label = format(dk(time), "%H:%M"))
  made <- dk(ie$made_utc[1])
  h1 <- ie |> filter(bucket == 1) |> summarise(across(c(down, none, up, mean, q10, q90), mean))
  h1_dir <- names(which.max(unlist(h1[, c("down", "none", "up")])))
  ic <- intra |> filter(model == "clim", bucket == 1) |> summarise(across(c(down, none, up), mean))
}

# latest day-ahead forecast (ensemble)
has_da <- !is.null(dayah)
if (has_da) {
  de <- dayah |> filter(model == "ens") |> arrange(time) |>
    mutate(label = format(dk(time), "%H:%M"))
  da_day <- as_date(dayah$date[1])
  da_avg <- de |> summarise(across(c(down, none, up, mean), mean))
  da_dir_counts <- table(factor(c("down", "none", "up")[max.col(as.matrix(de[, c("down", "none", "up")]))],
                                levels = c("down", "none", "up")))
}

# live track record: log loss of the ensemble vs the benchmark on the quarters known so far
has_live <- !is.null(live) && nrow(live) > 0
if (has_live) {
  live_tab <- live |>
    group_by(horizon) |>
    summarise(quarters = n(), from = min(time), ens = mean(ll_ens), clim = mean(ll_clim), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(skill = 1 - ens / clim, h = factor(horizon_labels[horizon], levels = horizon_labels)) |>
    arrange(h)
  live_skill <- function(h) { r <- live_tab[live_tab$horizon == h, ]; if (nrow(r) == 0) "\u2013" else pct(r$skill, 1) }
  live_from  <- format(dk(min(live$time)), "%d %b %Y")
}

# accuracy text
has_eval <- !is.null(scores)
eval_txt <- if (has_eval) {
  s1 <- skill_of("0-1h"); s4 <- skill_of("3-4h"); sd <- skill_of("day-ahead")
  t1 <- test_of("0-1h"); td <- test_of("day-ahead")
  sprintf(paste("The ensemble's log loss is %s lower than the benchmark for the next hour (DM %s),",
                "%s lower three to four hours ahead and %s lower for tomorrow (DM %s).",
                "The closer to delivery, the more there is to predict, but even the next hour is far from certain:",
                "imbalances are the errors in everyone's plans, so most of them are surprises."),
          pct(s1, 1), p_txt(t1$dm_p), pct(s4, 1), pct(sd, 1), p_txt(td$dm_p))
} else ""
period_txt <- if (!is.null(info)) sprintf("Backtest %s to %s, %s days, all horizons on the same days.",
                                          format(as_date(info_v("from")), "%d %b %Y"),
                                          format(as_date(info_v("to")), "%d %b %Y"), info_v("days")) else ""
rule_txt <- if (has_eval) {
  o <- skill_of("0-1h", per = "old rule"); n <- skill_of("0-1h", per = "new rule")
  od <- skill_of("day-ahead", per = "old rule"); nd <- skill_of("day-ahead", per = "new rule")
  sprintf(paste("Since the rule change on %s the direction is set differently, and \"no regulation\" happens",
                "about twice as often. Skill before / after it: next hour %s / %s, day-ahead %s / %s."),
          format(as_date(info_v("rule_change")), "%d %B %Y"), pct(o, 1), pct(n, 1), pct(od, 1), pct(nd, 1))
} else ""
has_spread <- !is.null(spread) && "horizon" %in% names(spread)
sp_of <- function(h, m, v = "pinball") spread[[v]][spread$horizon == h & spread$model == m & spread$period == "all"]
sp_p  <- function(h, v) sptest$dm_p[sptest$horizon == h & sptest$metric == v]
eur1  <- function(x) paste0(if (x < 0) "−" else "", format(round(abs(x), 1), nsmall = 1), " €/MWh")
spread_txt <- if (has_spread) {
  sprintf(paste("The spread forecast's pinball loss is %s lower than the benchmark's for the next hour and %s",
                "lower for tomorrow. With the direction known in advance it would be %s lower, so most of the",
                "uncertainty about the spread is about the direction."),
          pct(sp_of("0-1h", "ens", "skill"), 1), pct(sp_of("day-ahead", "ens", "skill"), 1),
          pct(sp_of("day-ahead", "perfect", "skill"), 0))
} else ""
value_txt <- if (has_spread) {
  sprintf(paste("Each quarter, settle 1 MWh at the imbalance price instead of the spot price when the expected",
                "spread is positive, and the other way round when it is negative. With the ensemble's expected",
                "spread that earns %s on average for the next hour (DM %s) and %s for tomorrow (DM %s), against",
                "%s and %s with the benchmark, and %s if the direction were known in advance.",
                "It shows how useful the expected spread is for a decision, not a strategy that could be run as is:",
                "positions are fixed when the markets close, and deliberate imbalances are not allowed."),
          eur1(sp_of("0-1h", "ens", "value")), p_txt(sp_p("0-1h", "value")),
          eur1(sp_of("day-ahead", "ens", "value")), p_txt(sp_p("day-ahead", "value")),
          eur1(sp_of("0-1h", "clim", "value")), eur1(sp_of("day-ahead", "clim", "value")),
          eur1(sp_of("0-1h", "perfect", "value")))
} else ""
```

```{r}
#| title: "How much lower the log loss is than the benchmark, by how far ahead"
if (has_eval) {
  sk <- scores |> filter(period == "all", model %in% c("ens", "mnl", "xgb", "persist")) |>
    mutate(h = factor(horizon_labels[horizon], levels = horizon_labels))
  p <- plot_ly()
  cols <- c(ens = "#f97316", mnl = "#2563eb", xgb = "#16a34a", persist = "#9ca3af")
  for (m in names(cols)) {
    x <- sk |> filter(model == m) |> arrange(h)
    if (nrow(x) == 0) next
    p <- p |> add_trace(data = x, x = ~h, y = ~skill, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
                        name = model_labels[[m]], line = list(color = cols[[m]], width = if (m == "ens") 3 else 2),
                        marker = list(color = cols[[m]], size = 8),
                        hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1%}<extra>", model_labels[[m]], "</extra>"))
  }
  p |> chart_layout("Forecast horizon") |>
    layout(yaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", zeroline = TRUE),
           shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 0, y1 = 0,
                              line = list(color = "#cfc6bb", dash = "dot"))))
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Scores (all test days)"
if (has_eval) {
  scores |>
    filter(period == "all") |>
    left_join(tests |> filter(model_b == "clim") |> select(horizon, model = model_a, dm_p), by = c("horizon", "model")) |>
    mutate(h = factor(horizon_labels[horizon], levels = horizon_labels)) |>
    arrange(h, log_loss) |>
    transmute(Horizon = as.character(h), Model = unname(model_labels[model]),
              `Log loss` = round(log_loss, 3), Brier = round(brier, 3), Skill = pct(skill, 1),
              `DM p vs benchmark` = ifelse(is.na(dm_p), "", ifelse(dm_p < 0.001, "<0.001", format(round(dm_p, 3), nsmall = 3)))) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "llrrrr")
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Calibration: forecast probability (x) vs how often it happened (y)"
if (!is.null(calib)) {
  p <- plot_ly() |>
    add_lines(x = c(0, 1), y = c(0, 1), line = list(color = "#cfc6bb", dash = "dot"), name = "Perfect", hoverinfo = "skip")
  for (h in c("0-1h", "day-ahead")) for (cl in c("down", "up")) {
    x <- calib |> filter(horizon == h, class == cl)
    p <- p |> add_trace(data = x, x = ~forecast, y = ~observed, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
                        name = paste(dir_labels[[cl]], horizon_labels[[h]]),
                        line = list(color = dir_colors[[cl]], dash = if (h == "day-ahead") "dash" else "solid"),
                        marker = list(color = dir_colors[[cl]]),
                        hovertemplate = "forecast %{x:.0%}, happened %{y:.0%}<extra></extra>")
  }
  p |> chart_layout("", "Observed frequency") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1)), yaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1)),
           hovermode = "closest", legend = list(orientation = "v", x = 1.02, y = 1))
}
```

#| title: "Spread forecast (imbalance price minus spot price), by how far ahead"
if (has_spread) {
  spread |>
    filter(period == "all", model %in% c("ens", "clim", "perfect")) |>
    select(horizon, model, pinball, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(pinball, value)) |>
    left_join(sptest |> select(horizon, metric, dm_p) |> pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = dm_p,
                                                                       names_prefix = "p_"), by = "horizon") |>
    mutate(h = factor(horizon_labels[horizon], levels = horizon_labels)) |>
    arrange(h) |>
    transmute(Horizon = as.character(h), `Pinball ensemble` = sprintf("%.1f", pinball_ens),
              `Pinball benchmark` = sprintf("%.1f", pinball_clim), Skill = pct(1 - pinball_ens / pinball_clim, 1),
              `DM p` = ifelse(p_pinball < 0.001, "<0.001", format(round(p_pinball, 3), nsmall = 3)),
              `Value ensemble` = sprintf("%.1f", round(value_ens, 1) + 0),
              `Value benchmark` = sprintf("%.1f", round(value_clim, 1) + 0),
              `DM p ` = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", format(round(p_value, 3), nsmall = 3)),
              `Value, direction known` = sprintf("%.1f", value_perfect)) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrrrrr")
}

```{r}
#| title: "Live forecasts: log loss of the ensemble vs the benchmark, per horizon"
#| output: asis
if (has_live) {
  live_tab |>
    left_join(scores |> filter(period == "all", model == "ens") |> select(horizon, bt = skill), by = "horizon") |>
    transmute(Horizon = as.character(h), Quarters = quarters, `Since` = format(dk(from), "%d %b"),
              `Log loss ensemble` = round(ens, 3), `Log loss benchmark` = round(clim, 3),
              `Live skill` = pct(skill, 1), `Backtest skill` = pct(bt, 1)) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrrr") |>
    cat(sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("The track record starts once the first forecast quarters have passed.")
}
cat("\n\nEvery forecast is saved before its quarter starts and never changed, and is scored once the",
    "imbalance data for that quarter is published. A few days of live data say little: the backtest",
    "needed months to show differences of a few percent.\n")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Live skill so far (lower log loss than the benchmark, cumulative)"
if (has_live) {
  cum <- live |>
    arrange(time) |>
    group_by(horizon) |>
    mutate(skill = 1 - cummean(ll_ens) / cummean(ll_clim), day = as_date(dk(time))) |>
    group_by(horizon, day) |>
    summarise(skill = last(skill), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(h = factor(horizon_labels[horizon], levels = horizon_labels))
  h_colors <- setNames(c("#f97316", "#fb923c", "#fdba74", "#fed7aa", "#2563eb"), horizon_labels)
  plot_ly(cum, x = ~day, y = ~skill, color = ~h, colors = h_colors, type = "scatter",
          mode = "lines+markers", line = list(width = 2.5), marker = list(size = 7),
          hovertemplate = "%{y:.1%}") |>
    chart_layout() |>
    layout(yaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", zeroline = TRUE),
           xaxis = list(type = "date", tickformat = "%d %b", dtick = 86400000))
} else {
  cat("No scored forecasts yet.")
}
```

# Method

::: {.card title="How it works"}

**What is forecast.** In each quarter-hour, Energinet balances DK1 by activating mFRR reserves up or
down. The direction of that activation sets the imbalance price: above the spot price when the system
is short (up-regulation), below it when the system is long (down-regulation), and equal to it when
nothing is activated. The models give the probability of each direction, and a forecast of the spread
between the imbalance price and the spot price.

**When.** Every three hours, for the 16 quarters of the next 4 hours (every hour in the backtest),
using the published imbalance data up to the quarter that started an hour before, and for the first
hour also the real-time state up to ten minutes before (aFRR activation, wind and solar production
against Energinet's forecast, DK1 cross-border flows). Once a day after the day-ahead auction, for all
quarters of tomorrow, using the imbalance data up to noon.

**Inputs.** Hour, quarter, weekday and holidays; the spot price of the quarter (level, negative,
shape over the day); wind and solar forecasts made 48 hours ahead (Open-Meteo); recent imbalances.

**Models.** A multinomial lasso (lambda by BIC), XGBoost, and their average (the ensemble). One model
per hour ahead, trained on the year before and refitted once a week. Benchmarks: how often each direction happened in that hour
over the last 28 days, and persistence (what followed the last known direction at that lead time).

**Spread.** A mixture: the 300 spreads in up-regulated quarters of the last 60 days with the closest
spot price, weighted by the probability of up, the same for down, and 0 for no regulation. The size of
the spread grows with the spot price, especially for down-regulation.

**Evaluation.** Log loss and Brier score for the direction, pinball loss and the value of picking a side
for the spread,
Diebold-Mariano tests on the daily average loss. The real-time inputs are only used for the first hour
because the backtest showed they help there and not further ahead. Energinet's newer wind and solar
forecasts for the hour being forecast (the 5-hour-ahead forecast, used only from 4 hours before the
hour, when its last part is published) were also tested and made no difference, so they are not used.
Most likely the market already trades on them, and the imbalance is what is left after that.
Recalibrating the probabilities on the last 60 days of forecasts helped after March 2026 but not before,
so it is not used either. The spread method, the newer forecasts and the recalibration were decided on
the months before March 2026 and checked on the months after.

**Data:** [Energi Data Service](https://www.energidataservice.dk) (Energinet), weather by
[Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com).<br>
**Code:** [github.com/jacobazu/dk1-imbalance-forecasting](https://github.com/jacobazu/dk1-imbalance-forecasting)<br>
